# DOD-9 external architecture comparison and DOD-10 evidence retention

Date: 2026-11-25 UTC. Advisory only, #603; no normative detector or workflow changes. No third-party speed claims adopted.

| System / primary source | Transferable mechanism | LexLean decision and falsification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [GitLab pipeline efficiency](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/pipelines/pipeline_efficiency/), [resource groups](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/resource_groups/) | Explicit dependencies permit work to begin when prerequisites are satisfied; supersession and serialized writers are distinct policies. | B1: remove only proven redundant dependency edges; exercise reverse event arrival and single-writer conflicts. Compare DAG makespan, allocated idle time and first actionable failure, keeping all test obligations. |
| [Buildkite parallel builds](https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/best-practices/parallel-builds), [retry](https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/configure/retry), [test client](https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines/configure/tests/bktec/installing-and-using-the-client) | Historical test timings inform partitioning; narrower retries preserve history. | Replay historical lane durations offline; balance by critical path and shared setup cost, not test count alone. Require complete disjoint inventory, failure plants and actual retained attempt custody. Do not import quarantine/muting as a normative pass. |
| [Bazel hermeticity](https://bazel.build/versions/8.0.0/basics/hermeticity), [remote caching](https://bazel.build/versions/7.3.0/remote/caching) | Reuse relies on bound action inputs, tools, command and environment. | A4 remains nonqualifying: read traces are an input-discovery aid, not proof of closure. Plant unobserved file/metadata/environment changes and demand invalidation. No remote build-output reuse adopted under the clean-checkout SPEC. |
| [Gradle build cache](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/build_cache.html), [Develocity build acceleration](https://docs.develocity.ai/2026.3/administration/build-acceleration/) | Explicit task inputs/outputs, separation of setup acceleration from execution, distribution and selection. | Separate initialization, execution and queue time; mutation-test declared inputs and outputs before considering reuse. Do not treat predictive selection or cache hit as an executed test. |

## Proposed independent next validation
Build a provider-neutral offline DAG/workload fixture: two dependency graphs with identical unit inventory, shared setup, deterministic failure, slow tail, cancelled lane, and an independent reproducibility obligation. Compare original barrier schedule, dependency-ready schedule, timing-balanced partitions, and same-source retained execution. Assert identical detector inventory and results with negative controls for a missing dependency, missing test, duplicate test, stale receipt, and failed retained job. A synthetic result establishes model behavior only, not savings or cross-language empirical qualification. Run an actual second-stack pilot only with separate bounded authorization. No CI provider migration recommended.
